mechanism: Moxifloxacin may increase risk of hyperglycemia and diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) in patients on SGLT2 inhibitors; additionally, both drugs can cause QT prolongation with additive cardiac effects.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely, assess for DKA symptoms (nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, dyspnea), monitor ECG for QT prolongation, and consider alternative antibiotics if possible.
